sentences.text: This dinosaur is distinguished by unique features including spongy back vertebrae, short neural spines, apneumatic ribs, and amphicoelous caudal vertebrae.
Researchers estimated Baotianmansaurus to be about 22.5 meters long, 5.3 meters tall at the shoulder, and weigh 21 tons.
Gregory S. Paul estimated Baotianmansaurus to be 20 meters long and weigh 15 tons.
Fossils of Baotianmansaurus were discovered in the Late Cretaceous Gaogou Formation of Henan Province, China.
The only known specimen of Baotianmansaurus, designated 41HIII-0200, is stored at the Henan Geological Museum in Zhengzhou.
Baotianmansaurus was named in April 2009 by a research team led by Zhang Xingliao.
The genus name Baotianmansaurus combines the Baotianman Nature Reserve with the Greek word for lizard.
The exact classification of Baotianmansaurus has been controversial since its description.
A 2019 study suggested a close relationship between Baotianmansaurus, Dongyangosaurus, and Diamantinasauria.
Recent analyses place Baotianmansaurus either as a non-titanosaur somphospondylian or as a basal titanosaur.
Baotianmansaurus is likely closely related to Opisthocoelicaudia and Dongyangosaurus.
Baotianmansaurus lived during the Late Cretaceous, approximately 75 million years ago in the Campanian stage.
The time range for Baotianmansaurus is estimated from 93.9 to 72.2 million years ago.
